description: Implementation of MonoPipe class for audio buffer management in Android, including buffer handling, writing, and timestamping.

classes.name: MonoPipe
classes.description: A class managing a mono audio buffer pipe with blocking and timestamp features.

methods.name: availableToWrite
methods.description: Returns the number of frames available for writing.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the pipe, simulating blocking I/O with sleep based on pipe fill level.

methods.name: setAvgFrames
methods.description: Sets the setpoint for the pipe fill level.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Sets the shutdown state of the pipe.

methods.name: isShutdown
methods.description: Returns whether the pipe is shut down.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the current timestamp of the pipe.
